widths.note: 12' from Betts to Beard Alley, 10' from Beard Alley to Laurel

ends.note: Beard Alley runs east from Felix Alley and dead-ends at the rear of the lots fronting Linn; it does not reach Linn

notes: North is up. Main area is Baymiller to Linn, Armory Av. (EVERETT) to Hopkins; the outlines west of Baymiller (sheet 71) and east of Linn (sheet 73) are drawn, so their alley mouths on Baymiller/Linn are included: on Baymiller the T's at y~1101, 2811 and 3706 are sheet 71's Clayers Alley, its unnamed 15'6" block-4 alley, and Stephenson Alley (none continue east of Baymiller); on Linn the T's at y~1102 and y~3708 are sheet 73's Clayers Alley and Stephenson Alley, which open onto Linn from the east only (neither runs through this sheet's blocks). Gorman and Barton come down from sheet 80 and end at Armory Av.; no widths printed (measure about 37 ft and 24 ft). Felix Alley is printed 'ALLEY' on its north half and 'FELIX' on its south half. Block 4 (Laurel to Hopkins) has no alley. Widths of streets with no foot label on this sheet were left out.
